### 2026-10-12 – wow, this is a lot harder,

**2.5h**

wow, this is a lot harder,

yep, defiently a bit harder then the other project, maybe cause I know less about it. Yeah, it took me two and hours to make it to the custom tracks section. Ive learned ALOT, the tutorial is very helpful and easy to follow. Other then this part "the point normal tool makes a plane, and the planes normal is the line. the plane is positioned at the point we have picked. so select the plane we just made, and a point on the end of the plane, these:"

Tommorrow I plan on starting the actual design for the marble run. Im going to try to find inspiration online like I did for my previous project. Thats about all I have planned =).

Thanks for reading my shorter then normal journal.

### 2026-10-13 – Starting to worry...

**3.1h**

Starting to worry...

This is alot more intensive and harder then last week. Im not sure if ill have enough time to  finish it in a week. Im going very slowly.

Today I spent ~2 hours maybe a bit more making a plinko board from the tutorial (plus what else i say, i didnt spend 2 hours on just the plinko). Im planning to use both the plinko and my twisting track in my actual design. As well, after school I worked on starting the design. All that I have so far is a little bit of marble run going into a funnel but its better then nothing. Gotta start working overtime. Hey atleast theres no coding. =)

A little burnt out and my laptop is almost dead, yeah I could plug it in but whatever. Maybe I come back with an edit for this.
